high_level_description: The image depicts a protest scene in New York City. The setting is an urban environment with tall buildings, including a prominent courthouse with classical architecture featuring columns and steps. The sky is clear, suggesting it is daytime. The crowd consists of numerous protesters, many of whom are holding signs. The signs are predominantly yellow and black, with messages such as "ICE OUT OF NYC" and "STOP THE DEPORTATIONS." Some individuals are also holding American flags, indicating a sense of national identity or solidarity.
